findings.summary: build_features is called on the whole dataset before the train/test split, so the mean and std include test rows, which leaks data and makes the test AUC optimistic.
The mean and std are recomputed on every call and never saved, so inference on a single row or small batch is scaled differently from training, or gives NaN because the std of one row is NaN.
A constant column or a one-row batch gives std of 0 or NaN, so the division produces NaN or inf and LogisticRegression.fit raises a ValueError (the reviewer did not reproduce this).
